prompt: Implement top_words(text: &str, k: usize) -> Vec<(String, usize)> in /work/src/lib.rs (a cargo crate with no dependencies). A word is a maximal run of ASCII letters and ASCII digits; every other character, including each non-ASCII character, separates words. Words are counted after ASCII lowercasing. Return the k most frequent words (lowercased) with their counts, sorted by count, highest first; words with equal counts keep the order of their first appearance in the text. Return fewer than k words if the text has fewer distinct words. The visible tests are run with: cargo test --offline
check_cmd: cp .hidden/hidden.rs tests/hidden.rs && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/target cargo test --offline --test hidden
